1. What Jorna is

Jorna is a marketplace. It connects clients planning an event with vendors who provide services — venues, catering, DJs, dhol players, mehndi artists, photographers and others. Jorna does not provide those services. The contract for the event service itself is between the client and the vendor. We are not a party to it, we don't supervise the work, and we don't guarantee any outcome.

2. Who can use Jorna

You must be at least FILL: minimum age, and old enough under your local law to enter a binding contract, to book or sell services. One person, one account. Keep your sign-in details to yourself — you're responsible for what happens under your account.

3. Bookings and prices

  • Vendors set their own rate and the unit it's charged in — per event, per person, per hour or per day.
  • Where a rate depends on a quantity, the total is calculated from what you enter: guest count, the number of days (counted inclusively), or the time window. Until you supply it, you're seeing a rate, not a total, and the booking can't be paid.
  • Some services are marked negotiable. You and the vendor can exchange offers, and the agreed figure becomes the price.
  • The amount is frozen when you pay. A vendor changing their listing later does not change what you already paid.
  • A booking is only confirmed once the vendor approves it and payment goes through.

4. Payment and escrow

Payments run through Stripe. Card details go to Stripe directly and never reach us.

Your money is held in escrow. When you pay, the funds are held by Jorna — not passed to the vendor. They are released only when both you and the vendor have confirmed, and the event date has passed. Every booking is handled separately: paying, refunding or disputing one has no effect on the others in the same event.

Vendors confirm by checking in at the venue, which uses your device's location to verify you're there. Where an event has no venue location on file, confirmation is a simple attestation instead.

5. Refunds, cancellations and disputes

  • Refund window. You can request a full refund within 24 hours of paying. After that, the booking is subject to the vendor's own cancellation terms, which you should agree with them directly.
  • Disputes. If something goes wrong, use “Report a Problem” on the booking. That freezes the money for that booking while our team reviews it. We may refund the client or release to the vendor based on what we find. Our decision on release of escrowed funds is final as between you and us; it doesn't stop you pursuing the other party.
  • Non-delivery. If a vendor doesn't show, raise a dispute before confirming. Once you confirm, release proceeds.

6. If you're a vendor

  • You must onboard with Stripe before you can be paid. Stripe's own terms apply to your account and payouts.
  • Jorna deducts a platform fee from each booking; the rest is transferred to your Stripe account when funds are released.
  • Your listings must be accurate — what's included, what it costs, and what you're actually able to deliver.
  • Keep your availability current. Accepting a booking you can't honour, or not turning up, may result in refunds to the client and removal from Jorna.
  • You're responsible for your own licences, insurance, and taxes.

7. Content and conduct

Jorna carries content you and others create: messages, reviews, profiles and photos. You keep ownership of what you post, and you give us permission to host and display it so the service can work.

There is zero tolerance for objectionable content or abusive behaviour. Don't post anything harassing, hateful, threatening, sexually explicit, discriminatory, deceptive, or unlawful. Don't impersonate anyone. Don't spam or scrape. Don't try to move a booking off Jorna to dodge fees or the escrow protections.

Every profile and message has report and block available. We review reports of objectionable content and act on them — including removing content and ejecting the user — within 24 hours. Blocking someone removes them from your search results, home feed, messages and reviews immediately.

Reviews must reflect a real booking and your genuine experience.

8. Suspension and termination

You can delete your account at any time in the app (Profile → Delete Account). We may suspend or terminate an account that breaks these terms, and we may withhold a release of funds where fraud or abuse is suspected while we investigate.

9. Disclaimers

Jorna is provided “as is”. We don't warrant that any vendor will meet your expectations, that listings are accurate, or that the service will be uninterrupted or error-free. We are not responsible for the conduct of any user, at an event or anywhere else.

To the fullest extent the law allows, Jorna is not liable for indirect, incidental, special or consequential losses, or for lost profits or lost events. Our total liability to you for any claim is limited to the amount of the platform fee we earned on the booking that gave rise to it.

Nothing here excludes liability that cannot legally be excluded.
